Подсветка сделана тегом <mark> с box-decoration-break:clone, поэтому фон не рвётся на переносе строки. Цитата лежит в <figure> с <blockquote> и <cite> в подписи. Соседние предложения приглушены цветом, но оставлены на месте. Две колонки включаются container query.

en.description: A document quote shown with its neighbouring sentences and the claim built on it — proof the fragment was not cut at a convenient word.

ai.summary: The grounding of an answer: a highlighted document fragment with context before and after, plus the model's claim tied to it. Zero dependencies, one file, no client JS.
preserve: the local --vibeui-ai-018-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens
the sentences around the quote: a torn-out fragment can flip the meaning
the <mark> tag rather than a tinted span — it is highlight semantics and page search understands it
box-decoration-break:clone: without it the highlight breaks across lines
<cite> in the caption — the source is tied to the text in markup, not only visually
the fragment address: a page and clause turn the quote into a checkable reference
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself
adapt: quote, before and after — the fragment and its surroundings
source, location and updated in the header
claim, claimTitle and confidence
openLabel, copyLabel and the accent through the accent prop
background — the component background; empty means no background, taking the page colour

Exactly what arrives in quote is highlighted: the block cannot find a fragment inside a long text.
The buttons do nothing: opening the document and copying belong to the caller.
A very long quote is not collapsed — trim it in the data.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the block has to stay a single file.

en.title: Document Citation

props.title: Grounding of the answer
props.before: The parties agree the scope of work in an annex to the contract.
props.quote: The contractor hands over the source code within ten working days from the date the acceptance certificate is signed, and from that moment the exclusive right passes to the client in full.
props.after: The handover is recorded in a separate act listing the repositories.
props.claim: The answer states that the rights to the code pass after the certificate is signed rather than after payment, and rests on exactly this clause. The handover period is ten working days.
props.claimTitle: How it is used in the answer

en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local variables --vibeui-ai-018-*. A server component: there are no hooks. The highlight is made with the <mark> tag and box-decoration-break:clone, so the background does not break at a line wrap. The quote sits in a <figure> with a <blockquote> and a <cite> in the caption. The neighbouring sentences are muted in colour but left in place. Two columns are turned on by a container query.

items.description: Первый экран чата: вместо перечня возможностей — готовые запросы, которые можно нажать, и честный список того, чего ассистент не умеет.

en.description: The first screen of a chat: clickable ready-made prompts instead of a feature list, plus an honest list of what the assistant cannot do.

the markup order — examples before the field, or keyboard order runs backwards

the aria-label on the field: the placeholder disappears at the first character
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself

en.title: Empty Chat

props.lede: Press a ready-made prompt or write your own. The assistant answers from the block catalogue and from the files you add.

Rewrite the heading so it carries one promise and not a single «innovative».
Explain how pricing-001 and pricing-003 differ and when to take the second one.
Check the page for accessibility: focus, contrast and heading order.

en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local variables --vibeui-ai-019-*. A server component: there are no hooks, and the input field is a plain form. The examples stand before the field in the markup, so they come first in keyboard order. The field frame is highlighted as a whole through :focus-within. The examples and the list of limits go into two columns through a container query.
